#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read data.csv, drop rows with age < 25, write cleaned.csv."""

import csv

INPUT_FILE = "data.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "cleaned.csv"
MIN_AGE = 25


def main() -> None:
    with open(INPUT_FILE, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        rows = list(reader)

    kept = [row for row in rows if int(row["age"]) >= MIN_AGE]
    removed = len(rows) - len(kept)

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=reader.fieldnames)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(kept)

    print(f"Kept {len(kept)} of {len(rows)} rows (removed {removed} with age < {MIN_AGE}).")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
